info.title: StickersAPI
info.summary: Free, unofficial sticker, emote, Telegram and PFP API
info.description:
Read-only API for stickers.gg stickers and packs, 7TV/BTTV/FFZ emotes, Telegram sticker sets, and pfps.gg profile pictures and banners.

No API keys. All endpoints are CORS-enabled and edge-cached. Try any request with **Send Request**.

- [Documentation](https://stickerapi.sbs/docs)
- [Guides](https://stickerapi.sbs/blog/)
- [llms.txt](https://stickerapi.sbs/llms.txt)

Not affiliated with stickers.gg, Discord, Telegram or pfps.gg. Content belongs to its uploaders and creators.

get.description: Machine-readable list of every endpoint, the API version and links to the landing page and docs.
Every sticker/emote source, its status and the endpoints it powers. Telegram shows whether the server-side token is configured.
Browse stickers by tag with sorting and pagination, or ask for a random selection.

get.description: Streams the sticker image. Add `?raw=1` to redirect to the CDN instead of proxying.
Returns the sticker as an attachment with its original filename.
A minimal HTML page that embeds the sticker preview. Useful for iframes and previews.

get.description: Builds a ZIP of the pack. ZIPs are capped at 48 stickers by default (`MAX_ZIP_FILES`); larger packs return 400.
Full-text sticker search. Returns up to 100 results, 50 by default.
